deploy_limitations.guardianFactorProviders: Pinned auth0-deploy-cli 9.1.0 with node-auth0 7.4.0 drops provider public fields during export: lib/tools/auth0/handlers/guardianFactorProviders.js reads provider.data although SDK methods return the body directly. Actual local CLI export produced an empty list after documented API PUT/GET succeeded. 9.2.0 ships the same handler. Classified tool-unsupported (maintainer, 2026-11-03): the same export is empty against Auth0. The documented provider PUT/GET wire is asserted directly and the E2E lane fails once the handler stops reading provider.data. No production wire or dependency pin changes hide the tool bug.
